events.verdict: Clarke (MEM) makes contact to Green's (HOU) elbow that affects his jump shot attempt.
Tate (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position during Kennard's (MEM) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Clarke (MEM) briefly places a hand on Green's (HOU) back as he trails the play but the contact is marginal before the shot is blocked.
Green (HOU) and Kennard (MEM) briefly come together at the same spot pursuing the loose ball and the contact is incidental.
Eason (HOU) immediately removes his hand from Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) side as he enters his upward shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Clarke (MEM) absorbs the contact from VanVleet (HOU) on the perimeter.
Clarke (MEM) moves alongside of VanVleet's (HOU) path to the basket and the ensuing contact is marginal. VanVleet is off-balance when he comes to a stop, causing him to fall to the floor.
Kennard (MEM) places his off-arm against Tate (HOU) as he comes to a stop in the lane and Tate's momentum carries him away from the play.
Tate (HOU) obtains a legal guarding position in Bane's (MEM) path and absorbs the contact during the layup attempt.
Green (HOU) contests to the side of Kennard (MEM) and avoids making any illegal contact during the jump shot attempt.
A timeout is mistakenly awarded to Memphis and after realizing that Coach Jenkins (MEM) did not call a timeout, it becomes an inadvertent whistle.
Brooks (HOU) and Jackson Jr. (MEM) briefly engage and disengage during the throw-in.
Brooks (HOU) lowers his arm across Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm, affecting his shot attempt in the lane.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) briefly engages with Eason (HOU) before batting the loose ball away.
